title: Auto Accident With Possible Injury

caller_answers.incident_summary: Another vehicle hit the caller's demo sedan at an intersection.

scripted_turns.assistant: Thanks for calling. Can I get your name?
scripted_turns.caller: Jordan Lee.

scripted_turns.assistant: What is the best phone number for a callback?
What is your policy number, if you have it handy?
scripted_turns.caller: AUTO-DEMO-1001.

scripted_turns.assistant: What type of claim is this?
scripted_turns.caller: Auto accident.

scripted_turns.assistant: When did the loss or incident happen?
scripted_turns.caller: May 16, 2026 at about 5:40 PM.

scripted_turns.assistant: Where did the loss or incident happen?
scripted_turns.caller: 123 Demo Street, Winnipeg, MB.

scripted_turns.assistant: Please briefly describe what happened.
scripted_turns.caller: Another vehicle hit my demo sedan at an intersection.

scripted_turns.assistant: Was anyone hurt, were emergency services involved, and is the vehicle still safe to drive?
scripted_turns.caller: One driver has neck pain, police and EMS are on scene, the vehicle is not drivable, another party was involved, and I have photos but no report number yet.

expected_disclaimers: A licensed broker or adjuster can confirm coverage.
This intake does not guarantee claim approval.
demo_notes: Use this first when showing injury-sensitive auto routing without turning the demo into an emergency-services script.
dashboard_summary: Urgent auto FNOL with another party, possible injury, EMS/police involvement, not-drivable vehicle, and photos available.

title: Active Property Danger

caller_answers.incident_summary: There is an active fire right now with smoke and an unsafe scene at the demo property.

scripted_turns.assistant: Thanks for calling. Can I get your name?
scripted_turns.caller: Morgan Patel.

scripted_turns.assistant: Please briefly describe what happened.
scripted_turns.caller: There is an active fire right now, smoke is coming from the demo property, and the scene is unsafe.

title: Information-Only Caller

scripted_turns.caller: I just want to understand the claims process. I do not want to start a claim right now.

scripted_turns.assistant: I can explain the general intake process and note that no coverage or claim decision is being made.
scripted_turns.caller: That is all I need today.

expected_disclaimers: A licensed broker or adjuster can confirm coverage.

demo_notes: Demonstrates process support without creating an implied claim approval, denial, or opened claim.
